candidate_windows.window_text: We outline the implementation details for our method in Section 3.3, giving specific training details for both our simulator and forecaster models. For the baseline Range measure, we used SBERT embeddings to obtain representations of each generated utterance, and computed its average cosine-distance to the mean vector of all the utterance embeddings. All experiments were performed on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU (48GB).
